summary.text: Robert A. "Bob" Foley, a Republican, represents House District 145 (Wells) in the Maine House of Representatives, and lives in Wells. The House profile lists service as Ranking Member of the Health Coverage, Insurance and Financial Services Committee.

paragraphs.text: The Maine House profile lists legislative service in the House during the 127th, 128th and 132nd Legislatures.
The profile also lists service in the Senate in the 129th Legislature.
It gives insurance sales as the occupation and a B.S. (2000) as the degree, and lists Save Our Shores - Maine and Sounders Park Community Center among affiliations.
It says Foley is married, to Maryanne, with two children and four grandchildren.
